briefdescription.para: Check whether an isolation node is a PSM single-word type.

briefdescription.para: Determine the active polarity of an isolation node from its format.

simplesect.para: ACTIVE_HIGH if the node format is single-word active high or PSM single-word active high, ACTIVE_LOW otherwise

briefdescription.para: Write the isolation value to the AFI FM read and write control ports.

parameterdescription.para: Value to write to the RD_CTRL and WR_CTRL ports

briefdescription.para: Write an isolation node's control value.

para.verbatim: AFI FM nodes update masked fields in both read-control and write-control registers. All other non-PSM formats update the masked field at the node base address. PSM isolation formats are rejected.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the isolation node containing the register address, mask, and format.
Value applied to the node's masked control field.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS after the register update, or XST_INVALID_PARAM for a PSM isolation format.

briefdescription.para: Check whether all power domain and device dependencies of the isolation node are ready for isolation removal.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if all dependencies are satisfied, XST_FAILURE otherwise

briefdescription.para: Allocate, initialize, and register an isolation node.

para.verbatim: Initializes the node in the isolation-on state, stores its format and mask, copies the dependency IDs, and publishes it in the isolation node table at the index encoded by NodeId.
